Odoo: account $(dstuser) signed up

Odoo: two-factor authentication enabled for $(dstuser)
Odoo: API key created for $(dstuser) from $(srcip) (scope $(odoo.scope))
Odoo: API key removed by $(dstuser) from $(srcip)
